lead: A `.nvst` case that pins a log record now pins its own line numbers.
body: `rule:errors/a-record-names-where-it-was-produced` puts `"source":{"file":"case.nvs","line":N}` on every `Core\Log::write` record and ` at case.nvs:N` on the plaintext one, so a comment added anywhere above a write moves an expectation that had nothing to do with it. Write the prose first and take the numbers from the runner's own `actual:` block afterwards, never the other way round.
